description: Runs Python, JavaScript or TypeScript code in an isolated one-shot sandbox and returns stdout, stderr, exit code and artifacts (Daytona CodeRunRequest/ExecuteResponse compatible) Price: $0.002 a call (3 free calls a day without an API key).

argv.description: Command-line arguments for the program (sys.argv[1:] in Python, process.argv.slice(2) in Node)

code.description: The code to run (up to 1 MB of UTF-8)

env.description: Environment variables; keys must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]* (Daytona's rule)

files.description: Text files written into the work directory next to the program (up to 50, 1 MB each, 4 MB total); the entry point main.py/main.js/main.ts is reserved

outputs.description: Relative paths to read back after the run (up to 20); up to 1 MB each comes back base64 in outputFiles, larger in tooLargeOutputs, absent in missingOutputs

timeout.description: Run timeout in seconds, 1-120 (default 60); a timed-out run answers exitCode 124

name: execute-code
title: Runs Python, JavaScript or TypeScript code in an isolated one-shot sandbox and r
